title: CIA Officer Frank Snepp Discusses Planting Stories in Vietnam
summary: Former CIA officer Frank Snepp describes how, working in Vietnam from 1969 to 1975, he planted stories in major newspapers to support Agency goals. He notes that some younger reporters refused to take the bait.
why: Cited as a first-hand account of how intelligence agencies have placed stories in the press.

quote.text: also has a very revealing interview about how the CIA would plant stories
